title: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 18: Babylon Is Fallen

sense.text: “Behold clouds from the east and from the north unto the south, and they are very horrible to look upon, full of wrath and storm”: the clouds are chariots, and these chariots are not the chariots of the Most High; they are the chariots of the nations. This is talking about the wars of Armageddon, which are about to come upon the earth.

“They shall smite one upon another, and they shall smite down a great multitude of stars upon the earth, even their own star”: the stars that are smitten down are satellites, helicopters, planes, weapons.
“And then shall there come great storms from the south, and from the north, and another part from the west”: from the west, not our people, but America.

“And they shall pour out over every high and eminent place an horrible star”: these horrible stars are the intercontinental missiles. “Fire, and hail, and flying swords”: the flying swords are the smaller missiles.

“And they shall go stedfastly unto Babylon, and make her afraid. They shall come to her, and besiege her, the star and all wrath shall they pour out upon her”: this catches up to where we were last week, the ten horns turning on the whore. The ten horns, the European Union, the ten common markets, are the only ones with power enough to fight against Babylon; the Arab nations and the others don’t have the nuclear power to overcome this place. Even the European Union will not totally finish this place; that is why Christ is going to have to come and finish the job. In Revelation 17 the horns burn her with fire: that is their nuclear fire.

“Then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her”: they that bewail her are the merchants of the earth, which we are about to read about in Revelation 18. Remember this part.
“And they that remain under her shall do service unto them that have put her in fear”: the other nations will be war captives, out there in the valley of Jehoshaphat.

precepts.why: “Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot”: the Most High does have what the world calls UFOs. He calls them clouds, which are chariots.

sense.text: “And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power”: John is on the isle of Patmos, and he has just seen the vision of the beast with seven heads and ten horns attack the whore that sat upon the great red beast. “And the earth was lightened with his glory.”

“Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen”: John sees the vision of Babylon, which is America, being destroyed. “And is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird”: some brothers interpret this as white people running through America today. That’s not what it is talking about. To understand Revelation 18:2 you go line upon line, here a little, there a little, to Isaiah 34: the cormorant, the dragons, the poisonous serpents. That is the habitation of devils.
“Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people”: Isaiah prophesies through the spirit to all nations to come together to fight, to war.

“For the indignation of the Lord is upon all nations”: he is not gathering all nations for nothing nice; God is angry at all the nations. “And his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.”

“And the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll”: when you see the heavens roll together as a scroll, that is the mushroom cloud, the effect of an atom bomb or, in these days, a nuclear bomb. “And all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine”: the host that falls is the satellites and the planes up there.

“For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea”: Idumea is the Greco-Roman name for Edom, the homeland of Herod. John Hyrcanus forced the remaining Edomites to become Jews by circumcising them, as you read in the Maccabees; that is the group in Israel today, all of Herod. And Bozrah was the capital city of Edom. This Bozrah is not the heap of rubble in Jordan today: the capital of Edom today, the headquarters, is America.

“And upon the people of my curse, to judgment”: Edom is the only neighbor of the Israelites that was not given any promise of mercy from God. Every other nation will get some type of mercy, but not Edom. The answer is in Genesis 25: he was made that way; it had nothing to do with what they did. Romans 9 says they were fitted for destruction: created for it.

“The sword of the Lord is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams”: is Christ coming down to chop up lambs and goats? Go back to verse 2: he gathers the nations and their armies to the slaughter. The sacrifice is men. The lambs, the goats and the rams are the armies of the nations; write that down. “For the Lord hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.”

“And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls”: no mythical animals; this is all a metaphor. In the Latin Vulgate and the Septuagint the unicorn is the rhinoceros, uni meaning one horn. Isaiah compares all the armies of the nations, Edom included, to various animals, and they are there for the slaughter.

“For it is the day of the Lord’s vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion”: verse 8 is very important. There is a controversy over who the land of Israel belongs to, and who and where the twelve tribes of Israel are. On TV they take people’s DNA and compare it with Esau’s. If you want to prove you are Israel, does the Bible say go get your DNA checked? How you prove you are Israel is the curses of Deuteronomy 28.

“And the land thereof shall become burning pitch. It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever”: just like we read in 2 Esdras 15. “From generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever”: some say this is Babylon in Iraq, destroyed when the Persians took it. But people live in Iraq today; this says the smoke goes up for ever and nobody shall live there.

“He shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness”: how did this place ever rise and rule the planet? Is this the man that made the earth to tremble? That is why it is a mystery: they can never believe this is the place.

“They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing. And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof”: like the film I Am Legend, with no people there and the trees growing across the streets and the buildings. “And it shall be an habitation of dragons”: the dragons are serpents, poisonous snakes and animals of the snake family. Write that down.
“And the satyr shall cry to his fellow”: that is going into goats. “The screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.”

precepts.why: Didn’t we just read that? “They shall come to her, and besiege her, the star and all wrath shall they pour out upon her: then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her.” Isaiah’s smoke that goes up for ever is the same dust and smoke that goes up from Babylon in 2 Esdras.

sense.text:
“For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication”: the wine is lies, falsehood; the wrath is anger; and her fornication is spiritual fornication. When it speaks of wine and fornication it is speaking metaphorically, a similitude: God is comparing one thing to another. Babylon is not literally going around committing sexual sin; this is spiritual. “And the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her”: the kings of the earth joined with Babylon in her lies, in her spiritual fornication. “And the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.”

The main wine the nations drank, the one that brings the wrath of God upon them, is the confederacy to destroy God’s people. We always go to America’s political program, which is true, but the beginning of it was all the nations agreeing together against the Israelites, taking an oath to be in union with Esau against us. That is what Psalms 83 shows: all nations were in cahoots with Edom.

precepts.why: Where the wine is explained: “If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.” The word wine makes reference to lies, falsehood.
Christians get confused at the word fornication. “For the devising of idols was the beginning of spiritual fornication.” The fornication of Babylon is spiritual fornication.

sense.text: “Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God. For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head”: they that hate God have lifted up the head, like Deuteronomy 28, where the stranger gets up above you very high and you come down very low.

“They have taken crafty counsel against thy people”: against who? Thy people. “And consulted against thy hidden ones”: we, the Israelites, are the hidden ones; the truth of who we are has been hidden in the earth.
Verse 4 is very important. “They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.”
“For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee”: all the nations came together and agreed with one consent.

Now he names the nations. “The tabernacles of Edom”: number one; they came up with the plan. When the Renaissance came in force, around 1444 to 1453, Edom held counsel with all the nations, with some of the African nations and some of the Arab nations. Edom is the white man; “the Ishmaelites” are the Arabs; Moab is the Chinese; “the Hagarenes” the Egyptians; “Gebal” African; “Ammon” Japanese; “Amalek” the so-called Jewish people; “the Philistines” Africans, “with the inhabitants of Tyre”, another African family; “Assur”, the Syrians. “They have holpen the children of Lot”: Moab and Ammon. All these nations were confederate against us.

We all know what the Hamites and Edom did to us, and some know what Ishmael did, but very few know that the Chinese had us in slavery too. Get the book The Black Holocaust for Beginners by S. E. Anderson.

precepts.why: “Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.” Sinim is Hebrew for China; write that down. We were in captivity there.

What the Greeks did. “Yea, he magnified himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away”: write down that this is Antiochus Epiphanes. “And the place of his sanctuary was cast down”: what we read about at Hanukkah.

“And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression”: certain wicked Israelites who hated their own people made a covenant with the Greeks, just like in America today. “And it cast down the truth to the ground”: together they cast down God’s laws, and our nationality. “And it practised, and prospered.”

Antiochus made our nationality outlaw: “Neither was it lawful for a man to keep sabbath days or ancient fasts, or to profess himself at all to be a Jew.” So the truth cast down to the ground was our nationality and God’s laws.

“And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.” God killed him with an incurable disease.

The confederacy against God’s people under the Greeks. “And the merchants of the country, hearing the fame of them”: of the Greeks, “took silver and gold very much, with servants, and came into the camp to buy the children of Israel for slaves.” Mark the words the merchants of the country; we will read them again in Revelation 18. “A power also of Syria and of the land of the Philistines joined themselves unto them”: Syria and the Philistines are named in Psalms 83. Many nations joined with the Greeks, confederate against the Israelites.

Christ said it: “Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.” If you kept calling yourself a Jew or an Israelite you were hated; you had to conform. Even after the time of Rome you had to conform to being a gentile; Rome picked up the same policy Greece did.

“He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up?”: he compares the whole twelve tribes of Israel to a lion. “Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.” Christ said you shall be hated of all nations, so are those nations blessed or cursed? They are all cursed.

The ones in power know what happened to us; you don’t lead a nation and be dumb. Like the king in Esther who could not sleep and read the chronicles of Persia, they have records of everything. The president of Iran stood at the UN and spoke of the tens of millions abducted from Africa and other regions of the world, and asked why reparations are paid for the Holocaust but not to the nations affected by slavery, and the European delegates walked out. They know the history, but they will only go so far; they will never tell us who we are, because it disrupts their plans of power.

sense.text:
“And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her”: the Christian theologians teach that Babylon here is the Vatican; foolishness. Babylon is America, the land of the north, where the daughter of Babylon, Edom, dwells. Come out of her is a spiritual fleeing, not getting a plane ticket to another country: all nations drank of her wine, and there is no place you can go that is not under America’s influence.

“My people”: everybody that believes in Jesus is not God’s people; that is not in the Bible, that is something you heard on TV. My people is the children of Israel, from the Old Testament to the New. So the children of Israel are in Babylon, in the land of the north.

“That ye be not partakers of her sins”: her sins are changing times and laws: New Year’s Eve, the day beginning at midnight, the laws of marriage, Christmas and the holidays, the Sabbath moved from the seventh day to the first, the pork, the shrimp, freedom of religion. Under the Greeks there was no freedom of religion; Rome adopted the same policy after 70 AD, said you cannot call yourselves Jews, put us in slavery and changed our identities; then America and her allies did the same thing. Being born again means changing the holidays, the foods we eat, and the way we dress.

“And that ye receive not of her plagues”: if you take part in the sins of America, you will be cut off in the destruction when it comes.

precepts.why: This is how you prove it is not the Vatican. “Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord”: write down the land of the north, North America. “For I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven”: Israel was scattered everywhere, but he pinpoints the land of the north, this place right here. “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon”: the daughter of Zion would dwell with the daughter of Babylon.

Who the daughter of Babylon is: “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof. O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed.” Edom is the daughter of Babylon.

“Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul”: deliver your soul. This is a spiritual fleeing, not a physical fleeing. “Be not cut off in her iniquity”: her sins. “For this is the time of the Lord’s vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.”
You have to know how to shut down a Christian on my people. “That thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.” My people is the children of Israel.
“But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.” My people Israel.

“At the same time, saith the Lord, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.” He prophesied through Jeremiah that he would end the old covenant and institute a new covenant, and they shall still be my people.

My people in the New Testament: “For out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.” From the Old Testament to the New, my people is Israel; that is how you close the mouths of the Christians.

Some of her sins, saying the same thing Jeremiah 51 said. “And he shall speak great words against the most High”: this white man, Edom. “And shall wear out the saints of the most High”: he wore us out in slavery and changed our racial identities. “And think to change times and laws”: one of the times he changed is New Year’s Eve, which some of your families are about to celebrate.

The Bible teaches that the new year begins in the spring. “Observe the month of Abib, and keep the passover unto the Lord thy God.” Abib is a Hebrew word that means ear of corn, which refers to the spring.

“This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.” The year begins in the month of Abib, in the spring; your friendly neighborhood white man says January 1st, in the winter. So he changed that time.

He also said the day begins at twelve midnight, which the occult calls the bewitching hour. “And the evening and the morning were the first day.” Read on: “the evening and the morning were the second day”, the third, the fourth, the fifth, the sixth. The evening and the morning make one day, and it begins with the evening: sun is down, the next day begins. When Christ returns we are going right back to what God says.

The next thing they changed is the laws of marriage. “And the rib, which the Lord God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.” Some Israelite groups teach that the rib means a close relative, like his sister; that is not what it is talking about. “She shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man”: woman means of man; she came from man. It does not mean slave or servant. “Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.” The Most High established marriage in Genesis 2 between male and female; Babylon the great says same sex.
Paul confirms it: “For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.” Man was made from the dust of the ground, and the woman comes from man.

Holiday means holy day: when they call Christmas or Halloween a holiday, they are saying it is a holy day, and it is not. “Concerning the feasts of the Lord, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.” In Leviticus 23 the Most High gave us a list of holy days, and there are more: Purim in Esther, Hanukkah in 1 Maccabees 4 and John 10, the day of Nicanor, the day of Simon. America says we will make up our own holidays from ancient evil customs, and our people run headlong into them.

“And ye shall read this book which we have sent unto you, to make confession in the house of the Lord, upon the feasts and solemn days.” We were commanded to read on the feasts of the Lord and the solemn days.

Some say there is to be no gladness on the solemn days of God, and make videos condemning those who rejoice, dance and drink on Passover. “And the children of Israel that were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness”: great gladness, we were partying. “And the Levites and the priests praised the Lord day by day, singing with loud instruments unto the Lord.” We are supposed to play music and sing and dance and rejoice; God wants to see that, the beginning of a repentant heart. Nehemiah and Esther kept the feasts with gladness, even in captivity.

America did the same thing Greece and Rome did. “So that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men”: the dropping of the atom bomb on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, 1945; write that down. “And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles”: the white man’s science the Bible calls miracles.

“That they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live”: the image of Caesar Borgia, known today as Jesus Christ. Rome fell in 193 and came back in power in 1453, under the Renaissance; Leonardo da Vinci took Caesar Borgia as his model. “And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast”: they gave the image the life of Christ, because they were in rulership. “That the image of the beast should both speak”: through their media, television, magazines; the rash of movies about a white Jesus is by design, to offset the word coming from the Israelites. “And cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.”

It is the same thing Antiochus did: you could not worship as an Israelite and keep your identity; with the image came a new identity. “And whoso would not conform themselves to the manners of the Gentiles should be put to death.” If you did not conform to the Greeks’ religion you were put to death, and America did the same: if you did not conform to their Christian religion and identities, you were put to death. In Roots, Kunta Kinte was beaten to the brink of death until he accepted the name Toby. That is why we have these names; they beat our forefathers to make them take them.

The way you dress stipulates what you believe: you know a Roman Catholic priest, a Buddhist, a Muslim by their clothes. “I will punish the princes, and the king’s children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.” God says he will destroy those in strange apparel. He gave us a dress code: fringes, and a border of blue upon all your garments.

sense.text: “For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.”

“Reward her even as she rewarded you”: the you is the Israelites. “And double unto her double according to her works”: nobody is going to march their way or vote their way out of this. God is going to pay back double to Babylon exactly what Babylon, what Edom, did to us. Some Israelites think they can save the white woman; that is a sick mind. They are all going to get double.

“How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow”: America and her allies have set themselves up as a queen, like you read in Isaiah 47.
“Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire”: that is what we read last week in Revelation 17.

“And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her”: they lived deliciously through their economics, an economic boom from trade with America. They come here, get education, programs and grants to start businesses, with no credit report asked, and go back and build. And wherever they sent the twelve tribes of Israel as slaves, that was hundreds of years of free slave labor that built up the economies of these nations. “Shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning.”

“Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come”: one hour of death, famine and fire. Some say the hour of temptation that shall come upon the earth is the chip; you’ve got to be kidding. Verses 17 and 19 say it again: “For in one hour so great riches is come to nought”; “for in one hour is she made desolate.” The one hour is the hour of temptation, when America is destroyed. It is not saying you will get a computer chip and run around buying bread and sneakers.

precepts.why: One of her sins that reached unto heaven: “Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.” That is talking about space travel: they landed on the moon in 1969 and declared to the world, the eagle has landed.

What we read last week: “And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast”: the European Union, the ten common markets, “these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.”

Where is the hour of temptation? “Because thou hast kept the word of my patience”: the word of the Lord’s patience is the laws, because he needs patience with us to keep them and get it right to the best of our ability. “I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.” The hour of temptation is the one hour in Revelation 18: when that great destruction comes.

sense.text: “And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her”: we read it at the beginning of the lesson, in 2 Esdras 15, all they that be about her shall bewail her. “For no man buyeth their merchandise any more”: this connects back to Revelation 13, that no man might buy or sell except he that has the mark of the beast.

“The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones”, on to “slaves, and souls of men”: John is prophesying about the future. Babylon the great would be selling slaves, and that happened from 1492 on through the 1600s. 1 Maccabees 3:41 is the example of what the Greeks did with us.

“And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee.” “The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her”: where do these merchants come from? All the other nations, all that drank of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.

“That great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!”: put yourself in John’s seat. Look at New York City at night from a plane: it looks like diamonds. John is not recognizing buildings; he sees a lit-up area from the air, something never seen before, and he describes it the best he can as gold, precious stones and pearls. What he sees is Babylon from an aerial view at night.

“For in one hour so great riches is come to nought”: the one hour goes back to Revelation 3:10, the hour of temptation, the destruction. “And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea”: import and export, that is how you get big money. One black man had three ships, Marcus Garvey, and they got them sabotaged. Hugo Chavez had ships and gave cheap oil to the poor Black and Hispanic neighborhoods; he stood at the UN and called the president of the United States the devil, and somehow had a brain aneurysm and dropped dead.

In Revelation 13 no man can buy or sell; where is that word in verse 17? Trade. When you read, start putting precepts together.
“What city is like unto this great city!”: this city would be the greatest place on earth. That is why people talk about Africa but nobody wants to move there; everybody wants to stay here.

“Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her”: why would God avenge the holy apostles on Babylon when they died in Rome? All the people are back, right here: the apostles are back, and the people that killed them are back. Rome did not pay for what she did; this is the revived Rome, so he avenges everything on this place, double.

“And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea”: a millstone is a huge block for grinding. “Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down”: not through voting. They took this land by violence, and by violence this land goes out.
“And no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee”: no more work.

“And the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee”: no more weddings here. “For thy merchants were the great men of the earth”: the nations. “For by thy sorceries were all nations deceived”: television, political policies, amendments; God says it is all sorcery. Everybody is bewitched, including your mothers and fathers, and the only spell breaker is the Bible. Graduation is gradual indoctrination into America’s goals, ideals and beliefs, from the time we start watching TV. The witchcraft is so bad people think the thoughts from television are their own thoughts.

“And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth”: God is judging the blood of Peter, Paul, James, all of them, here, because they are all here. What they did not pay for back then, from the time of 70 AD, they are going to pay for now. That is why it says double unto her.

precepts.why: Remember this part from the beginning of the lesson: “They shall come to her, and besiege her”; “then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her.” They that bewail her are the merchants of the earth who weep and mourn over her.

Slaves and souls of men: John prophesies about a future context, and Maccabees is something that happened centuries ago, but it is the same happening. “And the merchants of the country, hearing the fame of them, took silver and gold very much, with servants, and came into the camp to buy the children of Israel for slaves.” This goes with Revelation 13: no man might buy or sell.

Rome is back. “That they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live”: the wound by the sword was Rome dying, falling in 193 AD; and did live, they came back in 1453 on up to today.

“And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death”: that was Rome. “And his deadly wound was healed”: they came back in the 1400s, in the Renaissance. “And all the world wondered after the beast.”

A precept for her sorceries. “Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot”: the whore that sat upon the beast with seven heads and ten horns, Babylon; well favoured, because everybody wants to come to America. “The mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts”: didn’t we just read in Revelation 18 that she sells slaves and souls of men? Not only the nations are under her spell; our people are under a spell as well.
